messages:
Nora Chen: Hi all 
Nora Chen: Baby arrived at 35w, currently in NICU. My paid parental leave ends 2030-08-01 but discharge might be later. Do we have a NICU extension or top-up policy? Also need to pause laptop auto-recall and arrange oncall coverage.

Maya (People Ops): So glad you reached out and congrats, Nora. :heart: Yes — we offer a NICU pay-top-up for primary caregivers with documented neonatal hospitalization (up to 6 weeks). Please upload the physician note to the medical extension form: https://intra.redwood/hr/forms/medical-leave-extension (select NICU). After we receive docs and consent, we can provisionally approve the top-up same day.

Maya (People Ops): Quick steps: 1) upload physician note; 2) sign PHI consent; 3) optionally initiate STD claim (helps for wage replacement); 4) DM asset tag to pause device collection.

Nora Chen: Uploaded note (ref nicu-2030-550). Discharge estimate 2030-08-12. Signed consent.

Payroll Bot: Received nicu-2030-550. Payroll cutoff: if People Ops approves before 2030-08-05, top-up included in 2030-08-08 run; else next run. Top-up taxed normally.

Luis (Eng): Nora — we got you. I can take weekday oncall for first 3 weeks and move a contractor onto two tickets. Will update runbook and set calendar swaps.

Oncall Bot: Oncall change queued: Luis -> weekdays (2030-08-05 to 2030-08-26). Please confirm runbook access.

Maya (People Ops): Device hold placed for asset RDW-NORA-07. Phased return options: 3 weeks 50% or 4 weeks 60% - which do you prefer to plan for? Note: top-up covers leave period only; ramp pay follows actual hours.

Nora Chen: Prefer 3 weeks at 50%. Thanks everyone.

Legal: FYI if you want job-protected leave (FMLA/CFRA) we need physician note stating medical necessity and dates; People Ops will guide filing.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: approve provisional NICU top-up pending review, notify Payroll to queue top-up, create phased-return accommodation (3w @50%), schedule 15-min sync with Nora + Luis tomorrow. Case PO-2030-550 opened.

Nora Chen: Really appreciate the quick help and support.
